overall.basis: Printed '28'-0"' (8.534 m; metric print '8,4 m') and '40'-0"' (12.192 m; metric print '12,0 m'). The labels are arrow markers without extension lines, so their extent is fixed from the drawing: 28'-0" = 365 px = main-body left wall to garage right wall, 40'-0" = 521 px = garage front to family-room rear wall (13.04 and 13.03 px/ft agree; garage 12'-0", family 12'-0" x 15'-4" and dining 14'-0" labels confirm). Closed body = main body + enclosed garage + family room; the wrap-around covered porch excluded. Front = bottom of the plans (porch, entrance, garage door), confirmed by the render. Published Width 28' 0" and Depth 40' 0" equal the printed labels. heightM = published Height 27' 6" (no elevation).
